title: Plan your first step
intro: You'll write a short plan: when you'll start, and the first small thing you'll do. Then you'll read it twice.

goal.label: What do you want to start?

cue_question: When will you start? Pick the kind of moment that suits you:

cue_types.label: When I'm at a certain place
Right after something I already do

first_step.label: Then I will… (one tiny first action, under two minutes)
first_step.placeholder: e.g. open the notes and read the first example

obstacle.label: Optional: what might get in the way?
obstacle.placeholder: e.g. wanting to check my phone first

obstacle_response.label: If that happens, then I will…
obstacle_response.placeholder: e.g. put the phone in another room and start anyway

rehearsal.heading: Your plan
rehearsal.instruction: Read your plan to yourself twice, slowly. Picture yourself at that moment, doing the first action.
